holdout_notes: Subjects 11-30 were not used in the 1-10 pilot or to select method parameters.
The secondary four-frequency task uses 9.25, 11.25, 13.25, and 14.75 Hz, selected by spacing, not observed pilot accuracy.
The 12-class endpoint remains primary and must not be replaced by the easier four-class endpoint.
No training, personalization, or quality threshold is fitted on holdout subjects.
Both wet and dry electrodes and both 1 s and 2 s windows are reported regardless of outcome.
